decision.summary: The Federal Reserve lowered its target for the federal funds rate by 50 basis points to 1-1/2 percent.

changes.quote: FOMC statement: Federal Reserve and other central banks announce reductions in policy interest rates
changes.explanation: The Federal Reserve coordinated with other global central banks to lower interest rates in an unprecedented joint action during the financial crisis.

changes.quote: Inflationary pressures have started to moderate in a number of countries, partly reflecting a marked decline in energy and other commodity prices.
changes.explanation: Falling energy and commodity prices helped cool down inflation globally, giving central banks room to cut rates.

changes.quote: The recent intensification of the financial crisis has augmented the downside risks to growth and thus has diminished further the upside risks to price stability.
changes.explanation: The worsening financial crisis increased the threat to economic growth while reducing concerns about runaway inflation.

changes.quote: Some easing of global monetary conditions is therefore warranted.
changes.explanation: Central banks agreed that lowering borrowing costs was necessary to support the struggling global economy.

changes.quote: The Federal Open Market Committee has decided to lower its target for the federal funds rate 50 basis points to 1-1/2 percent.
changes.explanation: The Fed actively cut its benchmark interest rate by 0.50 percentage points to help stimulate economic activity.

tone_quotes.quote: The recent intensification of the financial crisis has augmented the downside risks to growth and thus has diminished further the upside risks to price stability.
Incoming economic data suggest that the pace of economic activity has slowed markedly in recent months.

for_you.text: On a $5,000 card balance at about 11.88% APR, a 50 bp cut lowers monthly interest by about $2.08.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury yield, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 3.72% and moved +22 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 6.09% would rise by about $42.83 a month.
High-yield savings rates usually follow the Fed partly; on $10,000 that means roughly $30.00 a year less in interest.
Unemployment was 6.1%, and employers added an average of -313k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 5% over the past year (September 2008); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 2%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a -2.1% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved +18 bp on the day.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved 1.55% on the day.

whats_next: The statement signals that the Committee will continue monitoring economic and financial developments to act as needed.
